certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — IAS 38 Intangible Assets

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the definition and recognition criteria for an intangible asset
Distinguish research from development and account for each
Account for intangibles acquired separately and in a business combination
Apply the cost and revaluation models for subsequent measurement
Account for amortisation of finite-life intangibles and testing of indefinite-life intangibles
Explain why internally generated goodwill and certain items are not recognised

integrative_case: A technology company buys a software licence, develops a new product through research then development phases, acquires customer relationships in a business combination, and owns a brand with an indefinite life; decide what may be capitalised, classify research versus development spending, measure and amortise the assets, and explain why its internally generated goodwill is not recognised.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
